title: LACUNA
description:
LACUNA explores the paradox of freedom, desire and self-dissolution. Inspired by the image of a moth drawn towards the very fire that threatens its wings, the work inhabits the fragile territory between liberation and destruction.

An intricate, almost mythical anatomy emerges, where the boundaries between human, animal and the unknown become indistinguishable. A body that holds multiple possibilities of existence, caught somewhere between creation and disappearance.

The work questions whether freedom is always an act of becoming, or sometimes an invitation to unmake oneself.

Perhaps what we seek to escape is also what gives us form.

title: Beyond
description:
Beyond

Beyond the boundaries of religion, identity and inherited beliefs lies a personal understanding of existence.
This artwork is an expression of my inner world, where motherhood, mythology, nature and the idea of the infinite come together. At its centre is Maa Kali, surrounded by animal forms, multiple eyes and intricate organic patterns. The imagery reflects my fascination with the many expressions of the universe and the mysterious ways in which we experience the unknown.

I don’t wish to confine the infinite to a name or a religion. I only know that I found an immense light in you, Kaali — a light I call Allah.

Born from a deeply personal space of contemplation, this work explores the coexistence of different cultural and spiritual influences without seeking to define or reconcile them.

Beyond is an exploration of existence, motherhood, humanity and the infinite light within — something that perhaps cannot be explained, only felt.

title: Kali and Her Many Forms
description:
Kali and Her Many Forms

An exploration of the feminine as an expression of nature, creation and transformation.
This artwork brings together the image of a woman and the organic language of flowers, leaves, intricate patterns and natural forms. Her presence seems to emerge from the very elements that surround her, blurring the boundaries between the human, the natural and the divine.

Inspired by the symbolism of Maa Kali and the multifaceted nature of womanhood, this piece reflects on feminine energy beyond conventional representations. She is both delicate and powerful, rooted and ever-changing, an embodiment of creation in its many forms.
Perhaps the woman and the goddess are not separate, but different expressions of the same infinite existence.

title: The Unfinished Species — Between Births
description:
THE UNFINISHED SPECIES — Between Births

An exploration of humanity as an unfinished journey. Moving through cycles of birth, death, suffering, resistance and renewal, we remain in a constant state of becoming. The cocoon becomes a world within itself — a womb, a refuge and a space of transformation. Rooted in the contradictions of our collective existence, the work questions whether humanity has truly evolved, or is still travelling towards its next beginning.

Perhaps we are not yet born…we are simply between births.

title: Kundalini — The Cosmic Chakra
description: An exploration of human nature as a reflection of the cosmos. Inspired by Kundalini and chakra philosophy, this artwork brings together serpents, human forms and elemental forces to explore the relationship between instinct, consciousness and universal energy. It reflects my fascination with the unseen forces that connect all existence, where the primal and the spiritual coexist, and the human being becomes a universe within itself.
